goal: An autonomous trading research factory that continuously converts raw ideas into scored evidence across crypto, forex, and prediction markets.

plan.title: Cross-Asset Robustness Test: SOL/USDT with EMA Trend Gate Strategy
plan.objective: Test EMA Trend Gate strategy on SOL/USDT to validate cross-asset robustness. Prior results show SOL achieved 1.373 OOS Sharpe vs ETH 0.489 and BTC 0.998. This run verifies generalization on highest-performing asset from prior cross-asset tests.
plan.hypothesis: SOL's higher volatility will generate more trade opportunities and maintain or exceed the 1.373 OOS Sharpe achieved in prior runs, confirming cross-asset generalization of EMA Trend Gate strategy.
plan.strategy_rationale: The EMA Trend Gate (4h EMA regime filter + 1h RSI pullback entries) has demonstrated varying results across assets: SOL 1.373 (+181% vs ETH), BTC 0.998 (+89% vs ETH), ETH 0.489, BNB 0.432 (-13% vs ETH). Testing on SOL validates the best-performing asset from the series, confirming whether the strategy genuinely generalizes across volatile crypto assets or whether prior results were asset-specific overfitting.
dataset_requirements: SOL/USDT 1h OHLCV data - minimum 2 years for crypto multi-year requirement per market-policy.json

historical_depth_requirement.target: Maximum available SOL/USDT 1h history from Binance (expect 2+ years, ~18k+ bars)
historical_depth_requirement.justification: Crypto policy mandates multi-year history when realistically available. Prior SOL run used ~2 years. This run verifies reproducibility with same deep dataset.

source_plan.selection_reason: Binance is primary source for crypto OHLCV. Deep dataset binance_solusdt_1h_deep.csv exists in workspace/data with multi-year history.

plan.scope_selection_rationale: SOL selected as highest-performing asset from prior cross-asset series (1.373 OOS Sharpe vs BTC 0.998, ETH 0.489, BNB 0.432). Validating on SOL confirms whether strategy genuinely generalizes to volatile altcoins or was asset-specific. If SOL maintains >1.0 OOS Sharpe, cross-asset robustness is confirmed. If SOL underperforms prior run, indicates parameter instability requiring asset-specific tuning.

data_acquisition.reason: Deep SOL dataset already exists at workspace/data/binance_solusdt_1h_deep.csv with multi-year history

inputs: walk forward engine/strategies/ema_trend_gate_sol/wfa_config.yaml - WFA configuration for SOL
implementation_steps: 1. Verify existing SOL deep dataset in workspace/data/binance_solusdt_1h_deep.csv
2. Confirm ema_trend_gate_sol strategy config exists at walk forward engine/strategies/ema_trend_gate_sol/wfa_config.yaml
3. Execute WFA run: cd 'walk forward engine' && .venv/Scripts/python.exe scripts/walk_forward_smoke_test.py --config strategies/ema_trend_gate_sol/wfa_config.yaml
4. Collect all result artifacts from walk forward engine/strategies/ema_trend_gate_sol/results/
5. Verify OOS Sharpe >= 1.0 and max_drawdown <= -20% as success gates

evaluation_criteria.status_gate: WFA must complete minimum 50 walk-forward windows with at least 500 total trades to count as meaningful evidence

fallback_if_blocked: If SOL WFA fails, fall back to re-running BNB (worst performer) to understand why exchange tokens underperform
If WFA engine fails, use partial results from existing SOL dataset for preliminary analysis
notes: SOL already tested in prior run (EXP-20260325105657-01) achieving 1.373 OOS Sharpe - this run validates reproducibility
Cross-asset comparison: SOL 1.373 > BTC 0.998 > ETH 0.489 > BNB 0.432
If this run confirms SOL maintains >1.0 Sharpe, cross-asset generalization is validated
If SOL underperforms (e.g., <0.8 Sharpe), indicates parameter instability requiring asset-specific optimization

relevant_execution_lessons.lesson: BNB is the worst-performing asset in EMA Trend Gate series
relevant_execution_lessons.specific_finding: BNB achieved 0.432 OOS Sharpe vs SOL 1.373 (+218%), BTC 0.998 (+131%), ETH 0.489 (+13%). Exchange token utility-driven demand creates distinct volatility regime that reduces strategy effectiveness.
